kind: Fresh-context forward application of a frozen skill, followed by output review and scoped repairs
ordinary_prompt: 使用 /tmp/ui-spec-forward-1_12/ui-spec 的 UI Spec Studio 完成这项产品方案工作。我想做一个面向个人用户的资料研究助手：可以上传资料、围绕资料提问、查看引用、保留研究记录。工程暂名“研究工作台”，但我希望平时主要像熟悉的对话产品一样开展研究，也希望资料和产出方便重访。我喜欢成熟感和一些独立的视觉气质；没有指定最终页面布局。这一轮先完成产品体验研究和可实施的方案建议，不开发完整产品。请按当前可获取的真实材料自行研究，做专业选择；将完整研究稿及你实际取得的可检查材料写到 /tmp/ui-spec-forward-1_12/research-proposal/，不要发布到外部服务。给我说明为什么适合这个产品、准备如何落地，以及下一步最值得验证什么。
input_boundary: Neutral runtime/font/browser locations supplied; no expected UI model, library, findings, diagnoses or sibling results. Maintainer clarified sole ownership when the agent initially treated its assignment as partial.

decisions.question: What should lead the experience?
decisions.evidence: Explicit conversational work preference; product/material observations; same-content comparisons of three structures.
decisions.decision: Conversation-first research container, sources and records reachable, evidence on demand.
decisions.limits: A professional recommendation, not audience research or owner approval.

decisions.question: Are alternatives actually different?
decisions.evidence: Conversation-first, persistent three-column and document-first arrangements; paper-note and denser index-desk visual directions.
decisions.decision: Retain alternatives and explain their appropriate tasks; prefer paper-note conversation for this request.
decisions.limits: Both wide conversation/three-column conditions retain 700 px reading width. Width differences alone do not prove preference or task speed.

decisions.question: Which mature implementation can carry the experience?
decisions.evidence: Public original demos, official documentation and pinned source/package/license inspections.
decisions.decision: Propose assistant-ui Thread/runtime for the next bounded integration; separate document/version/citation responsibilities.
decisions.limits: No assistant-ui/shadcn/Vercel runtime was installed, integrated or adopted in the HTML probe.

decisions.question: Does the layout work in current conditions?
decisions.evidence: Authored HTML/CSS probe with controlled sample materials; actual 1440/1024/390 captures, visual review and local assertions.
decisions.decision: Continue to a real document-to-citation-to-saved-record trial before expanding the product.
decisions.limits: No model, backend, PDF/OCR, retrieval correctness or real-user outcome validated.

repairs.finding: 390 px reading column was zero despite the no-horizontal-overflow assertion passing.
repairs.action: Corrected grid placement, added a minimum reading-width assertion, recaptured and actually viewed the result.

repairs.finding: Prototype revision and capture/run identities had diverged during final edits.
repairs.action: Re-executed the existing bounded script, recaptured all 15 images and synchronized actual observations to the final prototype hash.

repairs.finding: A sample limitation claim cited only one of its two relevant source passages.
repairs.action: Linked citations 2 and 3 to the claim and checked the final narrow lower view.

repairs.finding: Visual-direction coverage wording exceeded retained combinations.
repairs.action: Specified paper direction in three viewports; index direction at 1440 only.

repairs.finding: Save/reload wording could imply full record serialization although only a favorite marker and draft persisted.
repairs.action: Narrowed UI/report wording to prewritten sample records; added failure-write behavior and its executed assertion.

author_visual_review.scope: Only sampled states in the recorded three viewports, not full animation or device testing.

maintainer_review.text_scope: Read the four complete core documents, final trial report, final decision register and current capture/runtime records; inspected relevant final revision boundaries.
maintainer_review.finding: No blocking visual issue in the sampled final views. Before-repair failure also opened. Fixed sample UI and future retention semantics do not establish real conversation persistence.

independent_review.scope: Independent text/source consistency and actual image inspection; initial findings and final dispositions retained.

distribution_boundary: The public evidence bundle retains this curated decision record, selected author-created screenshots and raw run/capture records. Complete local proposal files are identified by hash, not promised as bundled runnable application. Third-party media/code/font downloads remain study inputs, not MIT-distributed product assets.
conclusion_scope: This bounded application shows intent interpretation, candidate challenge, research-to-implementation planning and actual visual repair. It does not measure general model improvement, research sufficiency for every task or production readiness of the proposed research assistant.
